targetType: What the appliances are deployed onto: 'esx' (a standalone ESX host) or 'vcenter' (an existing vCenter).
targetFqdn: FQDN of the ESX host or vCenter the restored appliances are deployed to. For the management domain, leave blank to use the first ESX host in the extracted SDDC data.
targetAdmin: Administrator account used to log in to the deployment target (e.g. root for an ESX host, administrator@vsphere.local for a vCenter).
targetAdminPassword: Password for the deployment target administrator account.
restoredvCenterDeploymentSize: Size of the vCenter appliance to deploy (e.g. small, medium, large, optionally with a storage suffix such as small-lstorage).
vCenterOvaFile: Path on this machine to the vCenter Server Appliance OVA used to deploy the restored vCenter.
restoredNsxManagerDeploymentSize: Size of the NSX Manager appliance to deploy (e.g. medium, large).
nsxManagerOvaFile: Path on this machine to the NSX Manager OVA used to deploy the restored NSX Manager.
sddcManagerOvaFile: Path on this machine to the SDDC Manager OVA used to deploy the restored SDDC Manager.
newSddcManagerPassword: Password to set for the vcf, root and local admin accounts on the newly deployed SDDC Manager. Also used afterwards to log in to it.
vCenterBackupPath: Path to the vCenter backup on the backup location, e.g. 10.0.0.5/share/vCenter/sn_<vcenter-fqdn>/M_<version>_<timestamp>.
locationtype: Protocol of the vCenter backup location: FTP, FTPS, HTTP, HTTPS, SFTP, NFS or SMB.
locationUser: User account for connecting to the vCenter backup location.
locationPassword: Password for the vCenter backup location user.
sftpServer: FQDN or IP address of the SFTP server holding the NSX / VCF backups.
sftpUser: User account for the SFTP backup server.
sftpPassword: Password for the SFTP backup server user.
sftpServerBackupPath: Directory on the SFTP server under which the backups are stored (e.g. /media/backups).
nsxBackupPassphrase: Passphrase the NSX Manager backup was encrypted with.
vcfbackupFilePath: Path on this machine to the SDDC Manager backup file (vcf-backup-*.tar.gz).
sddcManagerAdmin: SSO administrator account used to authenticate to the SDDC Manager API (e.g. administrator@vsphere.local).
sddcManagerAdminPassword: Password for the SDDC Manager API administrator account.
restoredVcenterAdmin: SSO administrator account of the restored vCenter (e.g. administrator@vsphere.local, or administrator@<domain>.local for a workload domain).
restoredVcenterAdminPassword: Password for the restored vCenter administrator account.
restoredNsxManagerFqdn: FQDN of the restored NSX Manager.
restoredNsxManagerAdminPassword: Password for the NSX Manager administrator account.
restoredNsxManagerRootPassword: Password for the root account of the restored NSX Manager appliance.
svcAccountPassword: Password to set on the service accounts created on the rebuilt ESX hosts.
VcfUserPassword: Password for the vcf account on SDDC Manager.
RootPassword: Password for the root account on SDDC Manager.
localUserPassword: Password for the local admin (admin@local) account on SDDC Manager.
adminPassword: Password for the local admin (admin@local) API user on SDDC Manager.
opsRestoreScriptPath: Path on this machine to your own script that restores the VCF Operations appliances.
username: User name for logging in to VCF Operations.
password: Password for the VCF Operations user.
authSource: VCF Operations authentication source for the login (normally 'local').
offlineDepotFqdn: FQDN of the offline depot that serves VCF bundles and backups.
offlineDepotPort: HTTPS port of the offline depot (normally 443).
offlineDepotUsername: User name for the offline depot.
offlineDepotPassword: Password for the offline depot user.
VcfVersion: VCF version to download bundles for, e.g. 9.1.0.0.
LocalArchivePath: Path on this machine to the VCFMS backup archive (*.base.tgz) to extract.
encryptionPassphrase: Passphrase used to encrypt the VCFMS backups.
instanceFqdn: FQDN of the VCF instance that the VCFMS Services Runtime belongs to.
ipv4Addresses: Comma-separated IPv4 addresses for the Services Runtime IP pool.
size: Deployment size of the VCFMS Services Runtime (small, medium or large).
gatewayCidrIpv4: Gateway of the Services Runtime network, as an IPv4 CIDR (e.g. 10.11.10.1/24).
internalClusterCidrIpv4: Internal cluster network of the Services Runtime, as an IPv4 CIDR (e.g. 198.18.0.0/15).
vcfmsServicesRuntimeFqdn: FQDN of the VCFMS Services Runtime.
vcfmsServicesRuntimePassword: Password of the VCFMS Services Runtime system user.
sftpHost: FQDN or IP address of the SFTP server the Services Runtime backs up to.
sftpUsername: User name for the SFTP backup server.
sftpDirectory: Directory on the SFTP server where the Services Runtime backups are stored.
vcfInstallerFqdn: FQDN of the VCF Installer appliance.
originalConfigurationFile: Path on this machine to the saved original depot services configuration, restored after the temporary depot is removed.
vcfaServicesRuntimeFqdn: FQDN of the VCF Automation Services Runtime.
vcfaServicesRuntimePassword: Password of the VCF Automation Services Runtime system user.
vcfaIpv4Addresses: Comma-separated IPv4 addresses for the VCF Automation Services Runtime IP pool.
vcfaSize: Deployment size of the VCF Automation Services Runtime (small, medium or large).
vcfaGatewayCidrIpv4: Gateway of the VCF Automation Services Runtime network, as an IPv4 CIDR.
vcfaInternalClusterCidrIpv4: Internal cluster network of the VCF Automation Services Runtime, as an IPv4 CIDR.
ComponentType: Component whose ingress VIPs are updated: vcfa, vidb or ops-logs.
vips: One to three IPv4 addresses to set as the new ingress VIPs.
FleetVip: IPv4 VIP of the Fleet LCM ingress.
NetworkMoId: vCenter ID of the port group (e.g. dvportgroup-28) the Services Runtime VMs connect to.
SystemUserPassword: Password of the Services Runtime system user.
ServicesRuntimePassword: Password of the Services Runtime system user.
KubeconfigPath: Path to the kubeconfig file for the Services Runtime.
BackupYamlDir: Directory holding the extracted backup YAML files.
OutputDir: Directory where output files are written.
RestoreJsonFile: Path to a JSON file listing the components (path and restore point) to restore.
SddcLcmSftpRemoteDir: Remote directory on the SFTP server used by the SDDC LCM backup secrets script.
SddcManagerUser: SSO administrator account used to authenticate to SDDC Manager.
SddcManagerPassword: Password for the SDDC Manager administrator account.
TargetVcfInstance: FQDN (or part of it) of the VCF instance to match, e.g. lax-ic01.lax.rainpole.io.
VcfOpsAdminPassword: Password for the VCF Operations admin account.
VcfOpsRootPassword: Password for the VCF Operations root account.
OpsFqdn: FQDN or IP address of VCF Operations that VCF Automation is re-registered with.
OpsPassword: Password for the VCF Operations user.
VcfaRuntimeFqdn: FQDN of the VCF Automation Services Runtime cluster.
VspPassword: Password of the admin@vsp.local account on the VCF Automation Services Runtime cluster.
VcfaSystemPassword: Password of the admin@System account on VCF Automation.
VidbFqdn: FQDN of the external Identity Broker (VIDB).
vspId: ID of the VCF instance (top-level folder on the SFTP server) whose backups are searched.
componentNames: Component types to find backups for (e.g. vsp, vcf-fleet-lcm, vidb, vcfa).
